question: Which share rows open this record, to whom, and why?

steps.name: shares
steps.soql: SELECT UserOrGroupId, UserOrGroup.Name, {level}, RowCause, LastModifiedDate FROM {share} WHERE {parent} = '{record}' ORDER BY RowCause

traps: Standard objects name the parent and level fields after the object (AccountId, AccountAccessLevel); custom share objects use ParentId and AccessLevel.
